reviews.title: Money stealers
reviews.text:
I signed up for tryout at $10 and chose the option not to auto renew and not to save my payment option. Guess what…they did anyway. I saw a pending charge for $55 two weeks later and went to the site and cancelled the program. They charged me anyway so I went back so I’d at least have access to what I paid for and I received an email that I was now back on auto renew!!  I went to the site again and there is NO PLACE to cancel the program in the app!
Long story short they suck.

reviews.title: The One You’re Looking For
reviews.text: I started using this app through the winter when it was too cold to be outside and I was too lazy to do all the prep for the gym. I am a cancer survivor and have lots of pain problems, some limited mobility and bad knees. This app was perfect! I loved the 30 day start up with exercises that are well demonstrated before the work begins. You know how long each exercise will take, how long the full session will last (usually about 10 mins) and you end feeling good all over. It helped with loosing weight and gaining tone without the days of being sore. There are chair only options and more advanced options. And… the customer service is prompt, courteous and helpful. If you’re thinking about getting started but worried you’re too out of shape, this is the one you’re looking for.

reviews.title: Good, easy daily exercise options
reviews.text: This app is really helpful for quick (10 min.) but effective daily exercises. Each day can be different. Lots of options including challenges. Easy, effective…really like this app! I highly recommend giving it a try. I think you’ll see results quickly if you’re consistent. Just grab it and get started!
